learning_outcomes.text: Students possess broad knowledge of the scope, characteristics, and essential areas of powertrain technology for motor vehicles.
Students possess practice-oriented knowledge of the vehicle powertrain and its components, and have a comprehensive overview of the current state of development for various drive aggregates.
Students can recognize and explain complex relationships.
Students are able to apply standard evaluation procedures and present the results in a structured manner. They are able to independently solve application-related tasks.

syllabus_topics: Structure, operating behavior of synchronous / asynchronous machines
teaching_methods: Independent study for event preparation and follow-up
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a written exam, the duration of which is specified in the valid study regulations. An ungraded experimental work, comprising 3-5 experiments, is also required.
